zh-CN.title: 聊天查找体验优化
items: 聊天记录查找现已自动加载后续内容，滚动时可快捷回到顶部
重新设计语音和文件结果，并完善媒体跳转图标、匿名或失效发言提示与列表字号

en.title: Improved chat history browsing
items: Chat history search now loads subsequent results automatically and offers a quick return-to-top action while scrolling
Voice and file results were redesigned, with clearer media jump icons, anonymous or unavailable post states, and refined typography
